description: Design system color tokens. All components must reference these token names rather than raw hex values.

primary.name: ARUP Red
primary.usage: Primary brand color. Primary buttons, key highlights, algorithm start-node borders.

secondary.name: Red Rock
secondary.usage: Secondary brand. Secondary buttons, filled card backgrounds, algorithm start-node fill, Zone C accent.

accent.name: Granite
accent.usage: TABLE borders, modal dividers, standard UI separators. NOT for card borders — use accent3/Badlands.

accent2.name: Coal
accent2.usage: High-contrast UI elements, tertiary buttons, secondary/caption text.

accent3.name: Badlands
accent3.usage: CARD borders, chart grid lines, low-emphasis outlines. NOT for table borders — use accent/Granite.

accent4.name: Aspen
accent4.usage: Warm neutral. Algorithm Zone A accent. Supporting data-viz tone.

accent5.name: Hoodoo
accent5.usage: Terracotta orange. Algorithm Zone B accent. Supporting visual accents.

accent6.name: Light Aspen
accent6.usage: Lightest warm neutral. Secondary surface, footnote blocks, input backgrounds.

white.name: White
white.usage: Card and page backgrounds, button labels on solid variants.

textColor.name: Dark Sky
textColor.usage: ALL standard body text, headings, UI labels. The only permitted body text colour.

linkColor.name: Lab Blue
linkColor.usage: Hyperlinks and linked table cell values ONLY. Never for non-link body text.

do: Use dark-sky for all body and UI text
Use lab-blue exclusively for hyperlinks and linked table cell values
dont: Do not use lab-blue for non-link text
Do not use foundation reds for body text

primaryBackground.name: White
primaryBackground.usage: Default card/page background. Table odd rows.

background.name: Salt
background.usage: Page background, table even rows, panel fills.

tertiaryBackground.name: Badlands
tertiaryBackground.usage: Tertiary surface. Chip backgrounds, subtle differentiation.

secondaryBackground.name: Light Aspen
secondaryBackground.usage: Warm off-white. Input backgrounds, footnote blocks, secondary card surfaces.

semantic.note: Reserved for status communication only. Never use for decoration or data visualisation.

danger.name: Danger/Error
danger.usage: Error states, destructive actions, conflict alerts.

info.name: Glass
info.usage: Informational states, neutral alerts, info status badges.

warning.name: Warning
warning.usage: Caution states, warning alerts, warning status badges.

success.name: Success
success.usage: Success, confirmed, approved states. Reflex test badges.

do: Pair every semantic color with its container token for badge/panel backgrounds
Use semantic tokens exclusively for status communication
dont: Do not use semantic colors for chart data
Do not use danger token in place of primary red for brand elements

cards.name: Badlands
cards.usage: ALL card borders — 1px solid. NOT Granite.

tables.name: Granite
tables.usage: Table cell borders, modal dividers, standard UI separators.

do: Use accent (Granite) for table and modal borders
dont: Do not mix Badlands and Granite borders on the same component
Do not use Granite for card borders — it is too dark

algorithmZoneColors.note: Zone accent colors for grouped_branch_layout algorithms. Applied to zone header left-border accents.

zoneC.name: Red Rock
zoneC.usage: Zone C — Sequential diagnostic chain (e.g. MTC)

do: Always reference token names, never raw hex values
dont: Do not use semantic colors for charts
Do not use lab-blue outside hyperlink contexts
Do not swap Badlands and Granite border tokens
